chunks.heading: The Stripes Remain
chunks.notes: The chunk stacks repeated "I fell / I endured" constructions cataloguing the speaker's descent and endurance after internalizing another person's verdict ("a tiger can't change its stripes").

chunks.heading: The Stripes Remain
chunks.notes: The chunk closes with the speaker reclaiming the "stripes" as self-forged regalia rather than the other woman's prophecy, landing on an explicit final-triumph aphorism.
